resources.string: Secure storage is not available right now
Scanova could not open its encrypted storage on this phone. Your documents are still there. This usually passes: try again, or restart the phone first.
Scanova\'s keys on this phone are gone

The phone no longer has the key that unlocks Scanova\'s local storage (for example after a restore or a security reset). Documents already uploaded are safe on your server. Scans that were never uploaded cannot be recovered.
Everything Scanova stored on this phone is deleted, including scans that were not uploaded. You will connect to your server and sign in again.
Scanova %1$s is ready. It installs over this version; your documents and sign-in are kept.
This version is no longer supported by your server. Install Scanova %1$s to keep using the app. Your documents and sign-in are kept.
Android asks once before an app may install updates. Turn on \"Allow from this source\" for Scanova, then come back.
The update could not be installed
Your server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again from Settings.
Your server did not offer a valid update. Try again later.
There is not enough free space for the update. Free some space and try again.
The download was damaged, so it was not installed. Try again from Settings.
This file is not a Scanova update, so it was not installed.
This build is signed differently from the app on your phone, so Android would not install it over it. It was not installed.
